reportFocus: Evening mode for Taiwan time. Focus is the US setup for tonight and the provisional read-through into the next Taiwan session.
marketOverview: This evening report starts from a broad market scan rather than a fixed watchlist. Roughly 20 scan buckets and more than 60 tickers were checked across US indexes, rates, dollar, oil, AI semis, cloud, software, AI servers, power, memory, Taiwan foundry, ODMs, networking, cooling, memory, panels, power semis, robotics, financials, shipping, steel and biotech. Fresh signal is concentrated in US AI leaders, Taiwan AI-server ODM scale-up, memory pricing and Taiwan macro strength; shipping, steel, financials and biotech remain secondary tonight unless new Taiwan-local flow appears tomorrow morning.
topThemes: US AI leaders re-accelerate but valuation is rate-sensitive
Taiwan AI-server ODM scale remains the clearest next-day read-through
HBM and memory pricing stay firm enough to keep memory names relevant
Power, cooling and networking remain second-order AI winners
Taiwan macro stays strong, but FX and tariff uncertainty cap upside certainty
biggestRisk: The main risk is chasing AI enthusiasm after strong headlines while ignoring rates, FX and margin pressure. A second risk is over-reading tonight's Taiwan hypotheses before US trading and tomorrow's Taiwan cash session validate them.
watchlistAlerts: Fresh catalyst: Nvidia, Micron, Dell, Wistron and Computex-linked Taiwan infrastructure names carry the strongest incremental signal tonight.
Recent context: Oracle, Broadcom, Foxconn, TSMC and Taiwan macro data support the trend but are not all same-day catalysts.
Background thesis: power, cooling, networking and custom silicon remain valid second-order AI trades.
Low signal: Taiwan panels, shipping, steel, financials and biotech were scanned but do not have enough fresh evidence to dominate tonight's report.
Next Taiwan open: verify whether TSMC/ODM strength broadens into Delta, Accton, memory and power semis, or whether gains stay concentrated in the largest names.
emotionalWarning: Separate fresh catalyst from recent context. Do not promote a name just because it is popular, and do not downgrade a name just because it is not a first-tier AI leader if new evidence made it important tonight.

news.title: Fresh catalyst | Nvidia Q1 FY27 extended the AI spending cycle
news.summary: Nvidia reported revenue up 85 percent year over year to 81.6 billion dollars and data center revenue up 92 percent to 75.2 billion dollars. That remains the strongest single proof point that hyperscaler and sovereign AI spending is still expanding.

news.title: Fresh catalyst | Micron raised outlook on HBM and DRAM pricing strength
news.source: Reuters via TradingView, latest Micron coverage
news.summary: Micron raised revenue and margin expectations, citing HBM demand and stronger DRAM pricing. That keeps the memory chain relevant for both US names and Taiwan memory-related read-through.

news.title: Fresh catalyst | Dell lifted long-term growth targets but margins remain the trade-off
news.source: Reuters via TradingView, latest Dell coverage
news.summary: Dell raised long-term revenue and EPS growth targets on AI-server demand, but repeated that AI systems pressure margin because of component cost and aggressive pricing. That is a useful read-through for Taiwan ODMs: scale is real, but margin quality still matters.

news.title: Fresh catalyst | Wistron kept adding AI networking and factory-AI signal
news.summary: Wistron reported Q1 2026 revenue of NT$846.3 billion and announced more AI-networking and smart-factory cooperation with Nvidia on June 2. That makes it one of the strongest fresh Taiwan AI infrastructure names tonight.

news.title: Fresh catalyst | Wiwynn remains one of the clearest pure-play AI rack winners
news.source: Wiwynn investor update and Computex press release, May 2026
news.summary: Wiwynn posted Q1 2026 revenue up 62 percent year over year and highlighted optical interconnect, liquid cooling and HVDC power at Computex. It is a direct beneficiary if AI-rack demand stays strong.

news.title: Fresh catalyst | Compal showed non-PC mix improvement and rack-level AI ambition
news.source: Compal Q1 2026 results and Computex 2026 release
news.summary: Compal said non-PC revenue rose to 35 percent in Q1 2026 and explicitly showcased compute, cooling and power as one rack-level system at Computex. It is still lower-conviction than Quanta or Wiwynn, but it is no longer ignorable.

news.title: Recent context | Oracle reinforced the cloud monetization side of the AI trade
news.source: Oracle investor relations and Reuters market follow-up
news.summary: Oracle reported cloud revenue up 27 percent and IaaS up 52 percent, with booked infrastructure revenue pointing to durable AI-cloud demand. It matters because it supports the idea that capex is not just hardware for its own sake.

news.title: Recent context | Broadcom kept custom AI silicon and networking demand firm
news.summary: Broadcom said AI revenue rose 46 percent and guided another step up. That supports both the ASIC branch of the AI trade and Taiwan networking suppliers.

news.title: Recent context | Foxconn margins improved with AI server scale
news.summary: Foxconn reported Q1 2026 net profit up 19 percent year over year, and said cloud/networking products now account for nearly half of revenue. That is an important Taiwan validation point because it shows AI scale can improve mix, not just revenue.

news.title: Recent context | TSMC keeps posting strong AI-led growth but FX and tariffs are real risks
news.source: TSMC investor relations, April 16 2026 and monthly revenue page
news.summary: TSMC posted Q1 2026 profit up 58 percent year over year and April revenue up 17.5 percent year over year, while January to April revenue rose 29.9 percent. The demand backdrop is strong, but a strong Taiwan dollar and tariff uncertainty still matter for sentiment.

news.title: Recent context | Taiwan export orders stayed strong on AI and HPC demand
news.source: Reuters via TradingView, Taiwan trade coverage
news.summary: Taiwan export orders and exports have remained stronger than expected, driven by AI and high-performance computing products. That keeps the macro backdrop supportive for Taiwan tech even if tariff uncertainty remains unresolved.

news.title: Recent context | Taiwan GDP and exports show AI demand is visible at the macro level
news.source: Reuters via TradingView, Taiwan GDP update
news.summary: Taiwan GDP grew far faster than expected, helped by AI demand and pull-forward ahead of tariff deadlines. That helps explain why Taiwan AI supply-chain names keep surprising to the upside on revenue.

news.title: Recent context | Taiwan dollar strength is becoming an earnings quality issue
news.source: Reuters via TradingView, Taiwan central bank minutes and FX coverage
news.summary: Taiwan central bank minutes kept rates at 2 percent and highlighted tariff uncertainty, while recent Taiwan dollar strength has reduced import-price pressure but creates translation risk for exporters. This is a real counterweight to otherwise strong top-line stories.

news.title: Recent context | Power and grid bottlenecks remain the second-order AI constraint
news.source: Reuters via TradingView, PJM and utility coverage
news.summary: US grid and utility coverage keeps pointing to data-center power scarcity and higher capacity costs. That supports US utilities and power equipment names, while also supporting Taiwan power, cooling and efficiency suppliers as a read-through.

news.title: Background thesis | The AI winner list keeps widening from chips to full racks, optics, power and cooling
news.source: Cross-market synthesis from company filings and Reuters coverage
news.summary: The strongest conclusion from the scan is not a single stock call. It is that AI demand is propagating from Nvidia and TSMC into ODM scale, optics, power delivery, cooling and memory. That is why Taiwan second-order suppliers still deserve attention tomorrow.

news.title: Low signal | Taiwan panel and FOPLP stories were scanned but are not tonight's lead
news.summary: Innolux, AUO and HannStar still have narrative appeal, but tonight there is not enough fresh evidence to rank them above AI compute, ODM, networking, cooling or memory. Keep them in the radar, not in the core thesis.

news.title: Low signal | Shipping, steel, financials and biotech were checked but lack fresh catalysts
news.summary: Evergreen, Yang Ming, China Steel, major financials and selected biotech names were reviewed as part of the full-market scan. None had enough fresh price, earnings, policy or macro signal to replace AI-linked names tonight.

companyResearch.overview: Nvidia remains the central operating proof point for the AI build-out.

companyResearch.latestFinancialReportSummary: Q1 FY27 revenue rose 85 percent year over year to 81.6 billion dollars and data center revenue rose 92 percent to 75.2 billion.
companyResearch.valuationRisk: High valuation means rates and sentiment matter.
companyResearch.bullCase: If hyperscaler and sovereign demand keep compounding, Nvidia can stay at the center of the spend cycle.
companyResearch.baseCase: Base case is continued growth with periodic valuation resets.
companyResearch.bearCase: Any real capex slowdown or worse export curbs would hit expectations quickly.
companyResearch.whatWouldChangeView: A clear demand slowdown, lower cloud capex intentions or deteriorating gross margin would weaken the view.

companyResearch.overview: Broadcom is the best public proxy for the custom-silicon branch of AI.
companyResearch.businessModel: Designs custom AI ASICs, networking silicon and infrastructure software.
companyResearch.latestFinancialReportSummary: AI revenue rose 46 percent and management guided another step up in AI semiconductor revenue.

companyResearch.bullCase: More hyperscaler custom-chip wins would keep Broadcom on a second major AI curve.
companyResearch.baseCase: Base case is sustained AI revenue growth plus software cash flow support.
companyResearch.bearCase: A pause in ASIC projects or weaker software growth would reduce the premium.
companyResearch.whatWouldChangeView: Evidence that custom AI programs are slipping or that networking demand is stalling would change the view.

us.title: US Setup Tonight
us.overview: The US scan favors AI leaders again, but with more nuance than a simple GPU chase. Nvidia, Micron and Dell provide fresh catalysts; Oracle and Broadcom provide strong recent context; rates and the utility/power debate remain the key valuation and breadth constraint.
risks: Higher yields can compress expensive AI leaders even if fundamentals remain strong.

taiwan.title: Taiwan Next-Day Hypotheses
taiwan.overview: Taiwan is closed for the evening, so every conclusion here is a hypothesis for the next cash session. The strongest potential read-through is continued leadership from TSMC and AI-server ODMs, then broadening into Delta, Accton and selected memory names. Panel, shipping, steel, financials and biotech were scanned and remain lower-priority tonight.
risks: Taiwan-dollar strength can limit exporter enthusiasm.
Tomorrow's opening flow could stay concentrated in the largest names and skip the hidden beneficiaries.
Panel and lower-quality concept names can attract speculative money, but evidence remains weaker than core AI infrastructure names.
